title: Root, leaf, height, depth
summary: The words every tree question uses, measured on a real tree.

checkpoints.text: 50 is the root: the only node with no parent. 30 is the parent of 20 and 40, its children. 20, 40 and 80 are leaves: they have no children.
Finding 40: it is smaller than 50, so the walk went left to 30. Now 40 is larger than 30.
40 is two steps below the root, so its depth is 2. The root has depth 0, and its children have depth 1.
20 is a leaf: both sides are empty (height 0), so its height is 1.
Back at the root: its left side has height 2 and its right side has height 2, so the tree's height is 3. Height counts the levels on the longest path down. Some books count edges instead and get 2.
Depth is measured down from the root to one node. Height is measured from a node down to its deepest leaf.
